structured.answer: I didn't choose anything. The page lists a lot of tracks from companies I don't know (מור, אנליסט, מיטב) and none from the big banks. The only ones that sounded safe, "כספי (שקלי)", show around 4.3–4.4% over 3 years with fees of about 0.58–0.71%, and I can't tell if that's better than my deposit, so I'll ask you or the bank.

stuck.why: I couldn't see which company each row belonged to. The company name is only on a thin grey line between the groups, so for the first group I never saw the name.
I didn't know if 4.33% is per year or for the whole three years, or how it compares with my deposit.
I couldn't tell what the rings mean, and the blue-green and yellow look alike to me.
More than 100% made no sense to me and worried me.

used: Track names such as 'כספי (שקלי)', 'אג"ח סחיר', 'אג"ח ממשלתי'
Company group lines: מור, אנליסט, מיטב
skimmed: Row of filter buttons (מניות, s&p 500, עוקב מדד...)
Notice 'נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026'

Comparison with a bank deposit interest rate
The company name for the first group of rows

findings.what: Dark background with small grey text is hard to read, even enlarged
The company name only appears on a thin grey divider line, and the first group's name was never visible to me
Very busy table with many numbers per row and rings in colours that are close to each other
Doesn't say which tracks are low-risk or how they compare with a deposit
English letters 'S&P' and jargon on the first screen made me feel the page isn't for me
Orange warning that the data is out of date is worrying
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a return figure is unclear
